input.brief: Language packs: one file that carries a Bible translation language, prepared once on a computer and opened offline on phones in Latin America; travels by SD card, USB, Bluetooth; read by Servos, tc-study and an MCP server

direction.name: One motif
direction.idea: Take one shape from the subject and let it run the whole system. A drilling tool's octagonal cross-section becomes the buttons, the image masks and the loader. A two-account money app becomes two circles that recur as icon, inline dot and section colour. A café's striped awning becomes every band on the page. Look at the product, the logo, the object or the word in the headline and find the simplest geometry in it (a circle, an arc, a chamfer, a stripe, a notch, a ring). Then use only that shape, at three or four very different scales, everywhere a designer would normally reach for a generic rounded rectangle.
direction.composition: Hero: the motif appears once at enormous scale as a flat filled shape, cropped by the viewport (a circle 120vh across entering from the right, a chamfered block filling the lower half), with a short headline at 6–8vw and one supporting sentence set on the remaining ground, left-aligned on a shared margin. Through the page the motif returns as: the mask for every photograph (via `clip-path` or `border-radius` made from the same geometry), the shape of the primary button, the bullet beside list items at text size, and one full-width band that separates the two halves of the page. Sections use simple two-column or single-column layouts so the shape is the only thing with character.
direction.typography: A clean geometric or grotesk face that echoes the shape (round bowls for circles, squared terminals for chamfers). Medium weight; headings 6–8vw in the hero and 3–4vw after.
direction.colour: The motif carries the accent colour at large scale, flat. Everything else is ground and ink. A second motif colour is allowed only if the subject has a real pair (two accounts, two modes).
direction.imagery: Photographs appear inside the motif's shape. If there is product interface to show, it sits on a flat colour stage shaped by the motif. Draw the shape with CSS or a simple inline SVG path; do not draw illustrations.
direction.richness: One shape at many sizes. The giant cropped shape gives the hero mass and colour without a single image.
direction.pitfalls: One motif means one. A circle here, a hexagon there and a blob behind is the generated look this replaces. The motif must come from the subject and you must be able to say from where in one clause.

hero.name: Fragment on a shaped stage
hero.blueprint: A neutral ground. The headline occupies the upper-left third: two lines at clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 80px), medium weight, flush left on columns 1–6 at a 40px margin, starting 150px down. One supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, follows, then the single action as a small rectangular button. The rest of the screen belongs to one flat stage in a saturated colour: it spans columns 5–12, begins 42% down, and bleeds off the right and bottom edges. Its top-left corner is cut with the product's own shape using `clip-path` (a notch, a chamfer or a tab two columns wide), the only decoration on the page. On the stage, 56px in from its left and top edges, sits the main fragment of the interface at true size with labels at 13–15px, built in HTML and working: one panel or control about 620px wide, cropped by the bottom edge, never a whole window and never inside a browser or laptop frame. Mark its root with data-ui. Navigation is a plain row at 28px from the top: wordmark left and four text links right at 15px. Nothing overlaps the headline.
hero.mobile: The headline sits under the wordmark at 10vw on two lines, followed by the sentence at 16px and the button. The stage comes next at full width, bleeding off both sides and the bottom, its corner cut kept at 72px wide. The fragment sits 16px inside it at true size; if it is wider than the screen the right edge crops it rather than scaling it down.
hero.headline: A plain statement of what the product does in three to six words, two lines of up to about 16 characters each at 5.2vw.

type.note: Medium-weight grotesk statements at one large size against caption-size text: a two-size system with no bold. Suits portfolios, agencies and tools that speak in short declarative lines.

palette.name: Cobalt on sand
palette.note: Sand paper and one cobalt do everything: text, drawings and solid shapes are all the same blue. The button is a cobalt block with sand-coloured type, and no black or second hue is used.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Figure set by a slider
sections.blueprint: The number is the visitor's own. A flat field at least 88svh tall. Top-left, on the page margin: a question of two to five words at 36–44px that serves as the heading ('How many invoices a month?'). 28px under it, one control from the product at true size, 400px wide, root marked data-ui: a slider with its real label and current value, or a stepper, or a short numeric field, preset to a typical answer. Then a long gap. Bottom-left, on the same edge, the result at clamp(140px, 19vw, 320px), heavy, leading 0.8, tabular numerals, with its unit at 0.22em on the same baseline. It recalculates on every input event from a stated, honest formula. Bottom-right, on the figure's baseline, one sentence at 17px, 30ch wide, says how the figure is worked out. No other figure appears in the section.
sections.mobile: Question at 26px, then the control at full width with a 44px thumb. The figure sits at the bottom at 30vw with its unit beneath it at 20px, both flush left. The working-out sentence follows at 15px. The section is at least 84svh so the gap between control and figure survives.

sections.name: Stages as one bar
sections.blueprint: The product's progress bar, enlarged until it spans the page, is the diagram. One bar runs across columns 1–12, 22vh tall, built as a flex row of three or four solid segments with 6px gaps, root marked data-ui. Each segment's width follows how long that stage really takes (flex-grow from the true durations, 12% minimum), and each is a different flat palette colour, so the reader sees at once that signing up is a sliver and the rest is the product working. Inside every segment, top-left with 20px padding, its duration in words at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px): 'Two minutes', 'About a day'. Under each segment, on its left edge, one clause at 17px, 22ch wide, beginning with its order word. Above the bar, 64px clear of it, the heading: two to five words at clamp(48px, 6.4vw, 104px), flush left. Nothing else.
sections.mobile: The bar turns vertical: segments stack as full-width blocks whose heights keep the proportions, 72px minimum, 6px gaps, about 70svh in total. Each holds its duration at 22px top-left and its clause at 16px beneath. The heading sits above at 11vw on two lines.

sections.name: One control, blown up
sections.blueprint: A flat saturated field, full-bleed and 92svh tall, holds one working control from the product: the toggle, slider, segmented switch or record button the whole product turns on. Build it at true proportions with every dimension in em, mark its root data-ui, then raise that root's font-size until the control stands about 46vh tall. Anchor it right of centre so the section's right and bottom edges crop about a fifth of it (overflow: hidden on the section). It keeps its real label and value, now at poster size, and it works: operating it swaps the field between two palette colours and changes one word of the heading. The heading, two to four words at clamp(28px, 2.6vw, 40px), sits top-left on the page margin with one sentence at 17px beneath it. The lower-left third of the field stays empty.
sections.mobile: The field is 86svh. Heading and sentence sit top-left at 26px and 16px. The control is enlarged to about 130vw wide and anchored bottom-left, so the right edge crops its far end while its thumb or active segment stays within reach. It still works and still swaps the field colour.

sections.name: Line-up at one type size
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed flat section. The programme is a four-column table spanning the full width between 24px margins, with every cell at one size, clamp(20px, 2.1vw, 30px), one weight, no bold: the act or session flush left, the format starting at 33%, the room or stage at 66%, and the time range right-aligned at the far edge with tabular figures. Rows are 1.5em tall and separated by nothing but that leading; the fixed column starts do the organising. Day or part headings are a single line at the same size in the accent ink with 72px above and 20px below, and may be `position: sticky; top: 0` on a strip of the section's ground colour so the current day stays in view. Breaks and changeovers are rows set in capitals in the soft ink. There is no other heading. Comfortably holds 12–40 rows; with fewer than eight, raise the size to 3vw.
sections.mobile: Each entry becomes two lines: the act at 22px on the first, then format, room and time on one line at 14px in the soft ink with the time right-aligned. 18px between entries. Day headings stay sticky at the top on the ground colour.

sections.name: First step, already open
sections.blueprint: The page ends with the product's first screen already open. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, 90svh tall. Right, in columns 7–11, vertically centred: the product's own create dialog at true size, 440px wide, root marked data-ui, with its real title ('Name your workspace'), one text field holding an editable, believable example, one two-option segmented choice and its primary button. Inside the fragment the product's conventions apply, including the shadow its dialog normally casts. The field accepts typing, the choice switches, and the primary button is the page's only action: it carries the typed value into sign-up. Left, in columns 1–5, anchored to the bottom with 40px margins: the closing line, two to four words at clamp(56px, 7vw, 112px), leading 0.92, on two lines, and under it one sentence at 17px saying what happens after the button. The upper-left stays empty.
sections.mobile: The closing line leads at 13vw on two lines, top-left, with its sentence beneath at 16px. The dialog follows at full width inside 16px margins, at true size, its primary button 52px tall and full width. The field is at least 84svh; the dialog sits in its lower half.

sections.name: The mark, built large
sections.blueprint: On a flat colour field, the brand closes the page as a construction rather than as set type. Across the full content width and about 34svh tall, the wordmark is built from blocks: each letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle in a palette colour, the rectangles differ in height (60–100% of the band) and butt together with 4px gaps, bottoms on one line. Where the project has a simple geometric mark or motif, enlarge that instead, drawn as inline SVG from flat rectangles, circles and quarter-arcs with the same 4px gaps. Below, 56px lower: four columns of plain links at 15px across columns 1–8, and two addresses or contact lines in columns 9–12. A last row carries the copyright at the left and one small filled button at the right. Space and the block construction do all the separating.
sections.mobile: The block wordmark spans the full width at about 22svh tall; a long name breaks into two rows of blocks. Link columns go two across at 15px, contact lines beneath at full width, then copyright and the small button on one row.

references.name: SSTR - Friction Reduction
references.idea: Drilling hardware treated like precision consumer tech: a chamfered octagon taken from the tool's cross-section drives the buttons, icons and loader.
references.hero: The captured first viewport is the preloader: a 2 by 2 grid with hairline dividers, top-left quadrant solid orange with the slash-prefixed name at 5.6vw in black bold grotesk; top-right dark with a plus-sign dot grid and an orange square beside a percentage; bottom quadrants hold wireframe octagon stacks under small labels. The real hero is a full-bleed grey 3D render of a steel downhole tool rising from bottom centre. A two-line uppercase headline at about 3.5vw in light grotesk sits left-anchored at mid-height, with a short paragraph and an orange chamfered-corner button below. A slim bar holds logo left, five small caps links, globe and contact right.
references.type: ABC Monument Grotesk: bold for the loader mark, but headlines are regular or light uppercase with tight tracking at roughly 36 to 50px over 14px body. Uppercase labels at 10 to 11px carry a square orange bullet. Statistic numerals jump to about 6.7vw in a thin weight.
references.colour: #18191b #eff0f1 #ff5a2a #2f3032 #c3c4c8 — Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate; one safety orange marks buttons, bullets, the loader block and the highlighted chart series. Renders are desaturated steel so orange never competes.
references.imagery: Desaturated 3D renders of drilling tools, full-bleed in the hero and as a long drill string bending along a well path; thin wireframe octagon line drawings as service icons; a chart drawn in dots.
references.layout: Content sits inside vertical hairline rails about 35px in from each edge, with sections subdivided into two or three bordered cells. Dark and light sections alternate. Text blocks are left-aligned and narrow; a pinned well-path sequence breaks the grid with a full-bleed scene.

sections.description: Light grey section inside vertical hairline rails. An uppercase two-line heading at about 2.4vw sits top-left with an orange chamfered button under it. Below, three equal columns divided by hairlines, each about 230px tall: a wireframe line drawing of stacked octagons in the upper half, then an uppercase title at 13px and three lines of small grey body. No fills, no icon circles, no shadows.

Graphite section split into two bordered cells. Left cell, vertically centred: a tiny bracketed before-and-after range in caps, a statistic at about 6.7vw in thin grotesk, a one-word label and an orange chamfered button. Right cell: a line chart drawn entirely in dots, white for the baseline and orange for the improved run, with faint axis labels and a two-item legend using short colour bars.

Pinned full-viewport dark scene. A 3D drill string enters at top-left, runs down, bends through ninety degrees and continues along the bottom to the right edge, with bright tool segments spaced along it. A text block right of centre holds a small orange-bulleted label, a four-line uppercase statement at about 2vw and two lines of body. Bottom edge: a back-to-start link left, a chevron scroll cue centre, a skip link right.

steal: Derive one shape from the product (here a chamfered octagon) and reuse it for button corners, icons and loader graphics.
Draw charts with dots rather than lines and reserve the accent colour for the one data series you want read.
Turn the preloader into a branded four-cell grid that previews the site's colour blocks and wireframe icons.

references.name: Midnight
references.idea: The headline's circles are literally pictured: one blurred dark ring, sliced into horizontal bands, becomes the hero, the demo panel, the session cards and the footer.
references.hero: No navigation at all. A canvas fills the full width and the top 90% of the viewport: a huge out-of-focus dark navy ring on drifting taupe, sage and terracotta, cut into horizontal bands about 78px tall that are slightly offset like blinds. On the vertical centre line, starting 58px from the left, sit a small rounded-square line icon and a one-line headline at 48px in cream. On the same baseline, starting 59% across, a two-line 17px statement whose first sentence is white and bold while the rest drops to half opacity. The cream page background shows as a 90px strip at the bottom. No button.
references.type: Public Sans only, weight 500, tracking −0.04em. Headline 48px, mid-page statement about 38px on five centred lines, body 13–17px. Signature device: within one paragraph the first sentence is full strength and the remainder faded, replacing the usual heading-plus-subhead pair.
references.colour: #f4efe6 #07172a #867768 #687674 #a8735c #faf7f1 — Warm cream pages against midnight navy; the gradient mixes muted taupe, sage and terracotta around the dark ring. A peach-cream fills the small pill button. No bright accent anywhere.
references.imagery: An animated blurred ring gradient with band displacement and fine grain, used full-bleed in hero and footer, inset with 8px corners as the demo panel, and miniaturised onto three portrait session cards. No photos or UI screenshots.
references.layout: 30px side margins. Sections alternate between full-bleed gradient and cream type-only screens. Section headers split into left title and right small paragraph. Text blocks are short and often occupy one half of the width, leaving the other empty (the FAQ sits entirely in the right half).

sections.description: A full cream viewport with one centred paragraph of five lines at roughly 38px, about 820px wide. Only the opening sentence is dark; the remaining words are pale and darken progressively with scroll. Later, three small portrait cards, each about 115×180px with a mini gradient, a date at the top and a two-line label bottom-left, fan across the right side of the text, overlapping it with a soft shadow.

Header row: a two-line title at 34px on the left, a three-line 12px grey paragraph in the last fifth on the right. Below, a gradient panel spans the full content width, about 650px tall with 8px corners, holding a centred question at 34px in cream, a one-line caption, and an email capsule with an inline peach button; a small play capsule sits centred near its bottom edge.

A left-aligned two-line lead uses the dark-then-faded sentence device. Under it a two-by-two arrangement with no cards or borders, columns starting at 0 and 50%: each item is a 24px pale rounded-square icon, a quoted question as a 13px semibold title, then three or four lines of grey 12px text about 300px wide. A waitlist capsule floats fixed at bottom centre.

FAQ rows with hairlines and chevrons occupy only the right half of the screen above. The footer is the gradient again, full-bleed and about 190px tall: a two-line cream statement at left, an email capsule with inline button at right on the same line, and a row of tiny grey legal links along the bottom.

steal: Slice a soft blurred gradient into horizontal bands with small offsets so a familiar glow becomes a recognisable, ownable texture.
Replace heading-plus-subhead with one paragraph whose first sentence is full contrast and the rest half opacity.
Remove the nav from the hero entirely and put headline left and supporting line right on one shared baseline at mid-height.

references.name: The Content Architecture
references.idea: The product name becomes a rotating vortex of concentric text rings that you scroll into, and the sales argument is a ticking hours-lost counter beside an itemised receipt.
references.hero: Exact 50/50 vertical split. The left half is warm cream with a left-aligned stack starting a third of the way down at an 80px margin: one-line mono caps label, a two-line medium-weight sans headline at only 3vw, a four-line grey paragraph capped near 510px, then a black button notched into two joined halves beside a pale grey secondary. A mono scroll cue with a target glyph sits bottom-left. The right half is a charcoal canvas filled with concentric rings of white mono caps spiralling round a centre and cropped by the viewport. A dark boxed nav with a marquee strip floats top-centre across the seam; a minimap thumbnail sits top-right.
references.type: GeistMono carries two thirds of the page: caps labels, nav, buttons and receipt rows with dot leaders. GeistSans 500 sets quiet 43px sentence-case headlines with zero tracking. The only loud size is a counter numeral near 18vw, so three sizes in total.
references.colour: #f1eee7 #232323 #dedede #f28a1c #000000 — Warm cream and charcoal trade places section by section. A single small orange dot marks the paid action on the button and nav; no other hue appears.
references.imagery: No photographs. Canvas-drawn concentric rings of the product name in white mono over a faint dotted grid, later dissolving into scattered glyphs and inverted text fragments. Full-bleed and cropped by the viewport.
references.layout: An 80px left margin holds every text block. Headlines stay small at the top-left of tall cream sections while one oversized element (vortex, numeral, receipt) takes the opposite side. Floating nav, minimap and a help tab stay pinned throughout.

sections.description: Scroll transition between hero and first section: the camera pushes into the text vortex, rings scaling until letters are hundreds of pixels tall and cropped at every edge, the dotted grid showing between them. A solid cream disc opens at the centre and grows until it becomes the next section's background. A full-screen wipe built from the hero's own artwork, with the nav still floating above.

Pinned cream section. Top-left, a three-line 43px headline with a two-line grey note. Bottom-left, a tilde-prefixed numeral about 18vw tall counts from 00 to 24 as you scroll, with a mono caption and small chip beneath. On the right a receipt column framed by dashed rules fills line by line: mono caps rows grouped by day, dot leaders running to right-aligned hour values, the newest row inverted white on black.

The cream page ends in a band where the vortex returns as debris: tiny mono fragments, some inverted in black boxes, scattered sparsely and thickening upward into the dark ring pattern. Below it a plain footer: logo mark with a stacked two-line name on the left, two short mono caps link columns on the right, and a builder credit bottom-right.

steal: Split the primary button into two notched halves so a two-word action reads like a physical ticket, with one orange dot as the page's only accent.
Argue the cost of doing nothing with a pinned counter: a huge numeral ticks up while itemised mono rows with dot leaders append beside it.
Build the hero graphic from the brand name set on concentric rotating rings, then reuse it as the scroll transition and as footer debris.
